title: Traumatic hallux valgus following rupture of the medial collateral ligament of the first metatarsophalangeal joint: a case report.
journal: The Journal of foot and ankle surgery : official publication of the American College of Foot and Ankle Surgeons

sections.label: UNLABELED
sections.text: Metatarsophalangealjoint injuries of the great toe are receiving increasing attention in athletes. Significant disability and long-term morbidity can result from these focal injuries. The entity known as turf-toe is widely recognized. Rupture of the medial collateral ligament of the first metatarsophalangeal joint is less common. A case of traumatic rupture of the medial collateral ligament in the great toe of a soccer player, which progressed to hallux valgus deformity, is presented.
